items: The new look on iPhone and iPad, matching Apple TV: your top match big on Now, a match page with every feed and the stats, and Sports grouped by time.
Backup TV guides (Plus): add several, tried in order, to fill in channels your provider's guide leaves out, with suggestions for your country.
A new loading screen in the player: the turning letter globe, then Connecting, Buffering, Playing.

description: Find the match. Fix the stream. Keep watching. Amaviro is a TV player for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV that finds the channel showing your game and sorts out what goes wrong, on the TV service you already pay for.
